messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — FRA DC got flagged at customs, forwarder says ETA slipped ~14 days for the topoff. 28 units in the order, 4 arrived DOA. Need plan for split routing + RMA.
vendor-liaison: Update from our side: customs requested physical inspection which pushed ETA. We can split: 20 air replacements now, 8 by sea. Air option adds ~$1,200/unit.
anika: We need the DOA serials immediately to start warranty RMAs and RMA paperwork. Vendor, can you post serials?
vendor-liaison: RMA ticket 2026-778 created. DOA serials: SN-A1B2C3D4, SN-A1B2C3D5, SN-A1B2C3D6, SN-A1B2C3D7.
vendor-liaison: We can pre-authorize credit against those DOA units once depot photos are provided. Proposal: 80% upfront credit, 20% after inspection.
josh: 80% is borderline; customer-critical lanes expect 100% coverage. Any flexibility?
vendor-liaison: We can move to 90% pre-credit if Redwood covers AWB expedite fees for the 20 air shipments.
maria: Cost check: 20 air replacements = +$24k. Unit list price used for credit calc is $60k. 90% credit on 4 DOA => vendor covers $216k immediately; Redwood covers the $24k expedite which ops budget can absorb this month.
anika: Confirm HS code and invoice amendment so customs stops toggling the hold.
vendor-liaison: Using HS 8471.50.80. Commercial invoice amended and re-filed ~10 minutes ago; forwarder says customs acknowledged amendment but still scheduled a photo inspection.
sanjay: Routing: prioritize FRA DC with 12 live nodes and 16 planned. Suggest: send air to fill 12 live + 4 DOA replacements to FRA, rest by sea.
josh: Could we divert some air to AMS edge to reduce customs friction? Vendor, is diversion allowed and timing impact?
vendor-liaison: Diversion to AMS possible — adds ~48 hours transit. We can divert up to 10 units to AMS if Redwood confirms by EOD.
rma-bot: RMA 2026-778 logged. Status: pending-photos. Please upload depot photos within 72h to avoid credit holdback.
maria: Ops decision: approve 90% pre-credit and Redwood will cover AWB expedite for the 20 air units. Sanjay, confirm AMS diversion count by EOD.
sanjay: Confirming diversion: send 10 units to AMS, send remaining 10 air to FRA, schedule sea top-up for the remaining 8. I'll coordinate depot photos and mark RMA 2026-778 awaiting evidence.
anika: I'll attach HS code and amended invoice to the RMA ticket and loop in customs contact.
josh: Vendor-liaison, please send a one-line SLA for replacements + written confirmation of 90% credit terms and AWB billing reference so finance can pre-authorize.
vendor-liaison: SLA snippet: "Dispatch 20 air replacements within 48h of pre-credit confirmation; 90% credit issued upon pre-authorization for DOA serials; remaining 10% issued after depot photo verification; AWB billed to Redwood account REF: RDW-PO-4422."
maria: Got it. Procurement will process pre-credit and AWB charge. I'll update the ledger once vendor invoice posts. :thumbsup:
